title: Section
description: A heading that groups related items inside an artifact. Sections can contain sections. A section is not traced.

title.title: Title
title.description: Heading text of at most 60 characters, without its number. The number, for example 3.2, is derived from the position of the section.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Short text shown under the heading. Null when the section has none.
